Functions
diverge_read

function to read model files as well as post processing files. returns the corresponding class (diverge_model, diverge_post_patch, or diverge_post_grid). Makes use of to the file format specifications given in diverge_postprocess_and_write and diverge_model_to_file; discerning the different file types by their magic numbers

Parameters
fname

file name to read from (typically ....dvg)
